text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is finally here. It's the
season for
special training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During this period, many Umamusume
focus
diligently on their training.
However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It's finally here—vacation
time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with the serious face,
Trainer? You
should be celebrating since
we've finally got us
some free time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! In the West, people keep their
work and private lives separate. It's
important to set
boundaries between the
two.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'm going to spend the
summer
jaunting about with a glass of
tropical juice in
hand! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her excitement appears to be leading
her in a different direction than usual.
When I tell her we
need to properly
focus on training...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know I have to. I'm only talking
about
letting loose during break time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's play, run, and celebrate summer
during the
peak of our lives! ♪ Worry
not, for the world is
our oyster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl seems completely at
ease, but
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm? It seems like there's something at
the top of
that tree... It feels like we're
being watched.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Could it be a sniper? Or maybe a
Canadian
grizzly bear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flap, flap, flap!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah, it was just a bird...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I suppose even Mother Nature
can't keep
her eyes off me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's get going, Trainer. First, I want to
go for a
swim!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl rushes off and leaves
me
behind. I'm about to go after her,
but...
...Hehehe!
That's right... I see you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I can hear a faint laugh
from the
tree that bird had flown from.
